::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 25th 1862  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell
:::

Dear [Miss Grigg](people/person_586.qmd), 

I send a few papers with many thanks to you for dispersing them. [Miss Adams](people/person_15.qmd) and [her aunt](people/person_1870.qmd) are arriving today, and in all the troubles of getting into their house this afternoon.

yours sincerely

C M Yonge
